# package edge

```go
import "github.com/otfabric/go-sparkplugb/edge"
```

Package edge implements a Sparkplug B Edge Node: the NBIRTH/NDEATH and DBIRTH/DDEATH lifecycle with bdSeq and seq numbering, data publishing, rebirth on command, and optional waiting for the Primary Host's STATE with server walking across brokers.

## Variables

```go
var (
	ErrClosed       = errors.New("sparkplugb: closed")
	ErrNotConnected = errors.New("sparkplugb: not connected")
	ErrNoBirth      = errors.New("sparkplugb: birth not published")
	// ErrDuplicateID is returned by PublishBirth and PublishDeviceBirth when an
	// alias is used twice in one birth or by another part of the edge node.
	ErrDuplicateID = errors.New("sparkplugb: duplicate device or alias ID")
	// ErrInvalidState is not returned by this package.
	//
	// Deprecated: operations in the wrong state return ErrNotConnected, ErrNoBirth
	// or ErrClosed. It stays for source compatibility.
	ErrInvalidState = errors.New("sparkplugb: invalid state transition")
)
```

### type Metrics

```go
type Metrics interface {
	OnConnect(brokerURL string, d time.Duration, err error)
	OnPublish(messageType string, d time.Duration, err error)
	OnMessage(messageType string)
	OnStateChange(old, new State)
}
```

Metrics receives the events of an edge node, to count and time them: set it as Config.Metrics. Each method is called synchronously from the goroutines of the node: they must be safe for concurrent use, quick, and must not block. Embed NopMetrics to implement only some.

#### func (Node) Rebirth

```go

```

Rebirth re-publishes the full birth sequence: NBIRTH followed by DBIRTH for each online device, in the order the devices were first born. It resets the sequence counter per the spec.
